additional_info.subject: RE: ID0466073-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S1 313508370012]check on logs CRM:02678000609
additional_info.body:
Good morning Rosita,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0466073.
The ticket was opened for a logs analysis for charger
Y2/S1 313508370012
on 04.12.2025. I checked the logs, and I saw the following:
Around 2025-12-04T11:52:48 the user tried to authenticate via RFID.
The charger at that time was having a connectivity issue on the OCPP Backend router, toggling between ONLINE and OFFLINE.
At the moment of the attempts to authenticate with RFID, the OCPP Backend connection was offline. I checked the charger configuration, and the possibility to authenticate via RFID when the connection to the Backend is offline is not enabled:
The connection to the Backend came online, and a user was able to authenticate via RemoteStartTransaction (via App) at 2025-12-04T11:53:56
The charging session was authenticated and it started charging at 2025-12-04T11:54:31.
In conclusion, the reason why the user was not able to authenticate via RFID is that the connection to the Backend was offline at the moment, and the local offline authorization is not enabled from the Backend.
We are already investigating with the colleagues form RC-IT on these offline scenarios separately.
Please let me know if further analysis is required form service side, otherwise I will proceed to close the ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
